concept: The free homepage concept as an object, rendered in 3D (Blender). A printed homepage design for a made-up joinery firm lying on a charcoal table, with a blue swing tag tied to it: Homepage concept. Yours. Free when you book a call. Whole, then low across its headline, then the tag, then from above with the call to action. Charcoal, paper white, one Nexulabs blue tag and cotton string.
